scope: Rabat C8 geometry evidence for Yacoub El Mansour

decisions.reason: AURS certifies Yacoub El Mansour as a quartier/product locality, while OSM administrative data separately models Yacoub El Mansour as an arrondissement. The arrondissement boundary cannot be substituted automatically for the product-locality polygon.

sources.title: Secteur de projet Gare d'Agdal (55 ha) / Boulevard Hassan II Ville Rabat

guardrails: Administrative and product-locality semantics remain separate.
No arrondissement boundary is promoted as a neighborhood polygon without explicit equivalence proof.
No centroid, Voronoi split or name-derived contour is created.
No public map eligibility is changed.
